## Purpose On the ROCm/AITER MLA path of DeepSeek-R1, every decode step's per-layer q/k preparation runs: 1. `concat_and_cache_mla_rope_fused` (rope on q_pe/k_pe + the fp8 KV-cache write of `[kv_c | k_pe]` — already fused by the `fuse_rope_kvcache_cat_mla` compile pass). 2. a Triton concat+quant kernel assembling the fp8 decode query `[ql_nope | rope(q_pe)]`, launched via the `mla_decode_concat_quant_fp8` op. This PR replaces 1+2 for **decode-only** with a single AITER HIP kernel (`fused_qk_rope_concat_and_cache_mla`): rope (fp32), the fp8 KV-cache write, and the assembled quantized decode query in one launch, so: - the decode hot path drops from 2 kernel launches to 1 per layer (61 layers). - prefill and mixed batches are unchanged: they fall back to the same `concat_and_cache_mla_rope_fused` kernel the baseline pass uses **How it works**: - The MLA wrapper hands RoPE ownership to `MLAAttention` (`attach_rotary_emb`, eligibility decided once at load) and passes `positions` through; the graph then contains no rope and no `unified_mla_kv_cache_update` node, so the existing `MLARoPEKVCacheCatFusionPass` has nothing to match. - `forward_impl` branches per batch on `attn_metadata`: decode-only steps make the single AITER launch; steps with any prefill tokens call the same `concat_and_cache_mla_rope_fused` kernel the baseline pass produces (eagerly), then proceeds same as before --- **Before fusing** (4µs 759ns + 4µs 479ns = 9µs 238ns per layer, decode): **After fusing** (4µs 45ns, **2.08x** faster): ## Test Plan - Benchmark: DeepSeek-R1-0528, TP8, ISL 1024 / OSL 1024, 640 prompts at concurrency 64, greedy client (`vllm bench serve --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0`), fp8 KV cache, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4`. - Accuracy: full GSM8K via lm_eval (local-completions, 5-shot, n=1319). ## Test Result > [!NOTE] > Tests executed on an 8×MI355X node against the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image > (stock torch 2.12 / amd-aiter 0.1.19 / triton 3.7.1), as an A/B against vLLM `main` > (1f1f628859) on the same machine and container. ### Benchmark Concurrency | Version | Output token throughput (tok/s) | Change | Median TTFT (ms) | Change | Mean TPOT (ms) | Change | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | 64 | Main | 3041.14 | — | 906.53 | — | 20.17 | — | 64 | This PR | 3068.18 | +0.89% | 905.13 | -0.15% | 19.90 | -1.34% | Per-kernel (decode, per layer, from the profiled traces of the same two runs): `concat_and_cache_mla_rope_fused` 4.759 µs + Triton q concat/quant 4.479 µs → `fuse_qk_rope_concat_and_cache_mla_per_head` 4.45 µs (−4.788 µs/layer, −0.29 ms per decode step across 61 layers). ### Accuracy Test Full GSM8K evaluation with the env enabled (1,319 examples): |Tasks|Version| Filter |n-shot| Metric |Value |Stderr| |-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|-----:|-----:| |gsm8k| 3|flexible-extract| 5|exact_match |0.9553|± 0.0057| | | |strict-match | 5|exact_match|0.9545 |±0.0058| Baseline `main` on the same setup: 0.9522 / 0.9507. ---

nodes.body:
So this is making copies because of the `.contiguous()`. That can grow pretty large. For rope 64 it would be 128k x 64 x 2B x 61 layers ~= 1 GiB.  Can you gate this so only one layer does this? Something like

```
def _fused_rope_cos_sin(self, dtype):
    assert self.rotary_emb is not None
    return self.rotary_emb.get_aiter_cos_sin(dtype
```

And then 

```
def get_aiter_cos_sin(self, dtype):
    cache = self.cos_sin_cache
    key = (cache.device, dtype)

    if key not in self._aiter_cos_sin_cache:
        cos, sin = cache.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        self._aiter_cos_sin_cache[key] = (
            cos.to(dtype).contiguous(),
            sin.to(dtype).contiguous(),
        )

    return self._aiter_cos_sin_cache[key]
```

This way only the first layer creates the sin/cos cache.

def get_aiter_cos_sin(self, dtype):
    cache = self.cos_sin_cache

            cos.to(dtype).contiguous(),
